pool.text: Marcos de Noronha wanted to establish the state capital in the municipality of Pirenópolis.
Jose Vieira Couto de Magalhaes put forward a plan to move the capital.
Constitutional delegates officially included the idea of transferring the capital in the constitution.
A commission was created to choose where the new capital would be built.
The name Goiânia came about after a contest held by a local newspaper.
Goiânia was founded as a planned city by Governor Pedro Ludovico.
Pedro Ludovico used the name Goiânia for the first time, signing a decree creating the municipality.
A decree was signed transferring the state capital from the Cidade de Goiás.
The official inauguration occurred with the presence of the president of the republic.
The zoo was created, containing over one thousand animals including mammals and birds.
A medical radiation source containing radioactive caesium-137 was stolen from an abandoned hospital.
The Gross Domestic Product of the city was over thirteen billion Brazilian reals.
Under the new contract firmed, many aspects of the public transportation are being changed.
Goiânia has the lowest number of favelas among Brazil's metropolises.
A Mexican think tank found that Goiânia ranks as a dangerous city in the world.
The new Santa Genoveva International Airport started operating in May.
